newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CSFB RATES ZALAKERAMIA AS BUY, SEES GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: CSFB RATES ZALAKERAMIA AS BUY, SEES GROWTH.

text.p: CS First Boston (CSFB) rated the shares in Zalakeramia as "buy" saying the Hungarian tile manufacturer offers good growth opportunities.

"We continue to place a buy recommendation on Zalakeramia as we feel that it is one of the best organic growth companies in the region," CSFB's Budapest-based analyst Spencer Jakab said in a note to investors.
The company's valuation came after Zalakeramia released its January-September earnings reports on Thursday.
Zalakeramia reported 661 million forints of net earnings for the nine-month period, representing a 30 percent rise over the same period in 1995.
Its operating profit rose to 788.8 million forints, 49 percent over the corresponding period of 1995 and the operating margins rose to 27 percent from 21.2 percent.
"The results are basically in line with our forecasts, which we have left unchanged," Jakab said.
The analyst remained bullish about the company's longer-term outlook.
"The company has not made any announcements about its planned acquisition in a neighbouring country," Jakab said.
"Although we have no way of judging how close such an announcement may be (or if there will be one at all), we feel that it is likely to re-ignite interest in the stock."
